en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammed bin Hussain bin Abi Talib, from Ali bin Asbat, from Sulaym, the servant of Tarbal, from Hisham al-Jawaleeqi, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
of the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Glorified be Allah» [23:91] What does He mean with it? He said: Extolment.
